title: Kyoto iUP - Kyoto University International Undergraduate Program
about: Kyoto University International Undergraduate Program (Kyoto iUP), October 2027 enrollment, 40 places. Online applications run November 2 to December 3, 2026, 5 p.m. JST; Japanese proficiency is not required to apply. Fee JPY 9,800.
card_alt: Card for Kyoto iUP - Kyoto University International Undergraduate Program at Kyoto University, Kyoto, Japan, with an application deadline of 3 Dec 2026. The photo shows Tokyo Tower lit orange against the Tokyo skyline at sunset, representing Japan.
